regulations.notes: Dare County (Outer Banks) does not broadly restrict STRs and has a relatively permissive regulatory environment. Municipalities within Dare County (Kill Devil Hills, Kitty Hawk, etc.) require town-level vacation rental permits. Hosts must obtain NC sales tax registration and a Dare County Occupancy Tax Account for tax remittance. Conditional use permits may be required in some municipalities.
